intro:

This delightful browser game is all about guiding a lovable mummy through a magical world, collecting treats and avoiding obstacles in the process. With 20 increasingly difficult levels to conquer, Mummy Candies is the perfect treat for fans of puzzle games looking for a fun and challenging experience.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various obstacles, including explosive pumpkins that will send your mummy flying. But don't worry, with some careful planning and quick reflexes, you'll be able to overcome these challenges and collect all the candies and lollipops for your mummy.

The game's core premise is simple yet addictive, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels. With its beautiful visuals and charming soundtrack, Mummy Candies is a game that will keep you coming back for more. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, Mummy Candies is sure to delight.

So, if you're ready to embark on a sweet adventure, let's dive into the world of Mummy Candies and explore its features, gameplay mechanics, and strategies to help you become a master candy collector.
